name: com.tarkalabs.eaglescan.ui.BarcodeScannerActivity
description: Tarka Labs Eagle Scan opens a full-screen camera scanner when the app starts its barcode-scanning flow. It returns the scanned text to the screen that opened it, or returns a cancellation or error result.
disableEffect: The app's barcode-scanning flow will not open, so users cannot scan a code with this library.
